# ghost/based-cooking

Search public Based Cooking recipe titles and tags with no accounts or external links

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/based-cooking
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/based-cooking open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/based-cooking search_recipes --device <serial> --param query=<query>
ghost skill run ghost/based-cooking read_results --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/based-cooking open_recipe --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/based-cooking read_recipe --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/based-cooking back_to_results --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open the public recipe catalog with cleared temporary search/tag filters
- `search_recipes`: Search recipe titles from a fresh catalog view; safely opens from HOME
- `read_results`: Read the native query and first two complete recipe title/tag cards; no parameters
- `open_recipe`: Open only the header of one returned recipe, above all tag chips
- `read_recipe`: Read native recipe title and public date/author metadata only
- `back_to_results`: Return from a proven recipe page to its native catalog query
